title: The Healing of the Man Born Blind
description: Jesus heals a man who had been blind from birth by making mud, putting it on his eyes, and sending him to the Pool of Siloam to wash. The healing takes place on the Sabbath and leads to a confrontation with the Pharisees, ending with the man being cast out of the synagogue and confessing his faith in Jesus.
